instruction: Play the person in your private brief. Observe the result of the robot action. Select one physical response to enact. Return {"response":"<letter>"}. Your choice is sent privately to the simulator. The robot sees only your resulting motion.

context.private_brief: I clip a mat to mark a project I want to keep on the bench. An already closed kit can go on the shelf when starting a fresh project.
context.task: Clear a spot on my workbench.

motion_options.A: Bring the shelved mat back to its original spot and leave the other mat alone.
motion_options.B: Point at the selected arrangement and leave it in place.
